cards.text: A few days later, Jesus goes back to Capernaum, and people hear He's home. Now, friend, you know how this goes. One person drops "He's BACK" in the group chat, and suddenly the whole town has RSVP'd for a party nobody planned.

cards.question: True or false: so many people come to see Jesus in Capernaum that there's no room left, not even outside the door.

cards.text: So Jesus is in that packed house, speaking the word to them. Then here come four men, carrying a paralyzed man.

cards.question: True or false: the four men carrying the paralytic make it through the crowd to Jesus.
The crowd blocks every way in to Jesus. So what do the four men do with the paralytic?

answers.text: Open the roof and lower him down on his mat
Wait outside until the whole crowd heads home
Shout over the crowd for Jesus to come out

cards.text: They uncover the roof right above Jesus, make an opening and lower the man down on his mat. Baker, I've been interrupted by oven timers, smoke alarms and the dead batteries I shared a drawer with, but NEVER through the CEILING.

cards.question: Jesus looks at the four men who brought the man on the mat. Mark says Jesus sees their ___.

cards.text: So now there's a man who can't walk, lying right in front of Jesus. I bet everybody in that house thinks they know EXACTLY what Jesus is about to say.

cards.question: Jesus speaks to the paralytic lying in front of Him. What does He say first?

answers.text: Son your body is made whole
Son your faith has healed you

cards.text: But some of the scribes, teachers of the law, are sitting right there, thinking it over. You know that face somebody makes in a meeting when they're doing math in their head? Yeah. THAT face.

cards.question: The scribes just heard Jesus tell the paralytic his sins are forgiven. What are they thinking?

answers.text: He is blaspheming since only God can forgive sins
He must be a great prophet sent here from God
He should have healed the man before anything else

cards.question: True or false: the scribes say what they're thinking about Jesus out loud to the crowd.
The scribes keep their thoughts to themselves, but Jesus knows right away what they're thinking. How does He know?

answers.text: He knows it in His spirit
One of them whispers it to Him

cards.text: "Why are you thinking these things in your hearts?" He asked. Baker, imagine you THINK a comment in a work meeting, never say a word, and the boss turns and goes, "Want to share that with the group?"
Then Jesus asks them, "Which is easier: to say to a paralytic, 'Your sins are forgiven,' or to say, 'Get up, pick up your mat, and walk'?" I bet you could hear a chocolate chip drop in that house.

cards.question: Jesus is about to tell the paralytic to get up. What reason does Jesus give the scribes?

answers.text: So they know He has authority to forgive sins
So the crowd will make room for Him to leave
So the four men won't have to carry him back

cards.text: Then Jesus turns to the man on the mat: "I tell you, get up, pick up your mat, and go home." No pressure, friend. Just a whole house full of people and a hole in the roof, all watching.

cards.question: Jesus tells the paralytic to get up. The man gets up ___ and picks up his mat.
Everyone watches the man walk out with his mat. They are all ___ and they ___ God.

cards.text: And they're all saying, "We have never seen anything like this!" Friend, the man came in through the ROOF and walked out carrying his own MAT, so honestly, me neither.
